# QC14: 畅和堂 Changhe Tang

Wave 4 · Qichun Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=QC14` · Page: `/scenes/#QC14` · Row: `research/buildings/QC14-changhe-tang/`

## What it was

畅和堂 Changhe Tang, in the south-west corner by the Hanlin garden 澄怀园, on the site of Ertai's 晚香园 (from 1732) and Yin Jishan's 寻春园, derelict after 1770 and rebuilt in 1813: a three-bay gate 松路花龛 and a five-bay main hall in two rolls with side halls, among them 澄霞宇 (E0728). Jiaqing's poems are of 1814 (E0723-E0730).

From the inventory row: **built** 嘉庆十八年 1813; 1813 rebuilt; **destroyed** 1860 (S06, S49, S01, S220, S361).
